profile_text.body:
Technology Innovation Institute (TII) is a government research laboratory based in Abu Dhabi, UAE, operating under the Abu Dhabi Government's Advanced Technology Research Council (ATRC), which the site describes as overseeing technology research in the emirate. TII describes itself as a leading global research center focused on discovery science and transformative technologies, with teams of scientists, researchers, and engineers working across areas that the site indicates include robotics, cybersecurity, materials science, and advanced computing.

TII's primary AI product is Falcon, an open-source large language model released under the Apache 2.0 license and hosted in the UAE, with Middle East data residency. The project is positioned as a sovereign AI initiative, meaning it is designed to keep data and infrastructure within the region rather than relying on foreign cloud providers.

The held facts confirm TII is classified as a non-profit government laboratory, verified as of August 2026. No litigation, SEC filings, patent records, or MCP server registrations are noted in the available data.
